spec.assertion: buffApply defPct=25.92, self-scoped, finite expiresFrame, count === fullBurstStart count. Fails under the nearest-wrong burstCast keying (diesel is B2 competing with the fixed crown slot, so her own cast count is strictly smaller than the FB count). Paired inertness check: removing it leaves every unit's total byte-identical (defPct is v1-inert).
it.skip — the v1 boss deals no damage and there is no 'attacked' trigger, so the line is unreachable; payload is HP-only with no damage consumer.
it.skip — no primitive raises another buff's maxStacks (Candy 10→11), and 'in Attract status' is a SELF status the enemy-keyed targetStatus / requiresTargetStatus channel cannot represent.

buffApply stat maxAmmoPct (fails a maxAmmoFlat mis-encode), value 56.7, maxStacks 10 (fails an uncapped model), finite expiresFrame (fails a permanent model), self-only target. Cadence assertion pins applies === floor(normalHits/70) ±2, which fails under a shotFired trigger (~hits applies) and under a 150-hit trigger (~half). Damage discrimination: removing it strictly LOWERS diesel's total (a bigger MG magazine buys shots otherwise lost to the 151-frame reload) while leaving every teammate byte-identical.

Removing the instantReload strictly lowers BOTH diesel's total and the team total — the latter fails under a self-scoped mis-read of 'Affects all allies'. Trigger identity is ⚑: cadence asserted only as perAlly*5 <= candyApplies, which fails under a nearest-wrong 70-hit re-trigger but cannot pin removal semantics.

buffApply pierceDamagePct=30 with distinct targetSlug count === comp size and including diesel — fails under a self-scoped model (size 1). Timed (finite expiresFrame). Inertness: removing it leaves the whole totals map identical (pierceDamagePct is v1-inert with no pierce-tagged carrier), so the assertion is deliberately event-log-only.

Non-vacuity guard on diesel's burstCast count first. Hit count derived as (base damage events − burst-effect-removed damage events) must equal the cast count — fails under a 5-hits-per-cast reading of the target clause. Linearity: delta(atkPct→0) / delta(atkPct→half) === 2 proves the 299.66% is live and scaled. FB-exemption: the count of diesel damage events carrying fbMajorApplied===true is unchanged by removing the nuke, so the burst hit never took the +50% Full-Burst major.

maxHpFlat self-grant, count === diesel's own burstCast count (fails a fullBurstEnter mis-key, which over-fires), FLAT-resolved value > 0 (fails an assertion on the raw 100.05), finite expiresFrame. 'Without restoring HP' asserted as zero recovery/heal events sourced from diesel — fails a model that pairs the grant with a heal effect. Damage-inert (no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer): removing it leaves the totals map identical.
it.skip — targetStatus has no event kind, and both kit consumers of the Attract window (S1b/S1c) are themselves GAPs, so no observable behaviour depends on it.

Zero buffApply events with casterIdx === diesel for any offensive stat (atkPct / casterAtkPct / attackDamagePct / crit* / core* / damageTakenPct). Fails any model that fudges her Defender kit into a damage buff to explain a board reading.

fixtures: controlComp('diesel', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / diesel / helm B3, so bursts actually chain and Full Bursts occur. helm=false was rejected: it removes the only Burst III and the comp would produce ZERO Full Bursts, which would make the S1a fullBurstEnter line vacuous. Note the fixture's structural quirk: diesel is Burst II and shares the stage with the fixed crown B2 slot, so her own burstCast count is expected to be strictly below the Full-Burst count — that gap is what makes the S1a trigger-identity assertion (fullBurstEnter vs burstCast) and the burst-slot per-cast counts discriminating. Every burst-slot group is therefore preceded by an explicit non-vacuity guard on her burstCast count, so a fixture where she never casts fails loudly instead of passing empty. 8 hoisted 180s runs: BASE + 7 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals (defPct removed, maxAmmoPct removed, instantReload removed, pierceDamagePct removed, burst flatDamage removed, burst flatDamage halved, burst maxHp grant removed). Each counterfactual returns the number of effects it actually touched and every test asserts patched >= 1, so a no-op patch (wrong slot shape) can never turn a discriminating assertion green for the wrong reason — the packet documents the slot payload two ways (slot === Block[] vs slot.blocks), so slotBlocks() accepts both.
gaps: S1b 'Activates when attacked in Attract status → recovers 12.96% of final Max HP' — unreachable: the v1 boss deals no damage and there is no 'attacked' trigger; payload is HP-only with no damage consumer.

S1c 'After landing 150 normal attacks in Attract status → Stack count of buffs ▲1' — no primitive raises another buff's maxStacks (the Strawberry Candy cap 10→11), and 'in Attract status' is a SELF status while targetStatus/requiresTargetStatus is enemy-keyed. Would need both a maxStacks-delta effect and a self-status channel.

Burst 'Attract: Taunt all enemies for 10 sec' — targetStatus emits no event kind, and both of its kit consumers (S1b/S1c) are GAPs, so nothing observable depends on the window. Modelling it as targetStatus{name:'Attract',durationSec:10} on the enemy is a defensible proxy for the 10s window but is semantically inverted (the status sits on Diesel, not the boss).

S2b trigger identity is ⚑ — 'reaches max stacks of Strawberry Candy … Activates after stacks are removed' has no engine trigger. Nearest primitive is a hitCount:700 (10 stacks × 70 hits) proxy. The cadence assertion bounds it (fires no more than once per 5 Candy stacks) but cannot separate 'stacks lapse naturally at 10s' from 'stacks are consumed at cap' without footage.

Not asserted (outside a blind test's reach): whether the maxAmmoPct increase applies to the CURRENT magazine mid-belt or only at the next reload — the direction of the damage delta is asserted, the mechanism is not. Also the ⚑ MG cadence tuple (datamine-unreliable rate_of_fire) is taken as given by both the base and patched runs, so it cancels out of every counterfactual.
